snippet.title: Evolution - Neural Network & Genetic Algorithm
snippet.description:
A simple simulator that evolves user-built creatures using neural networks and an evolutionary algorithm. Free download links below:

Mac/PC/Web: https://keiwan.itch.io/evolution
Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.keiwando.Evolution
iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/evolution-simulate-learning-creatures/id1227314223?l=de&ls=1&mt=8

Inspiration:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=m4E9sj9vH1I
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pgaEE27nsQw
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=xcIBoPuNIiw
Jumping over a ball inspiration:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Gl3EjiVlz_4
